provider: NASA Space Physics Data Facility, CDAWeb HAPI, OMNI
originator: World Data Center for Geomagnetism, Kyoto

ae.epoch: Start of the one-minute bin; native sourceTime is retained.
ae.qualityScope: Period-level documentation. No per-record quality flag accompanies this HAPI parameter.

dst.epoch: Midpoint of the one-hour bin. For example, the unmodified 12:30 UTC source epoch denotes the [12:00,13:00) UTC hourly bin.
dst.qualityScope: Period-level documentation. No per-record quality flag accompanies this HAPI parameter.
dst.metadataDiscrepancy: The HAPI parameter description still lists a 2014 final-data endpoint and then provisional data from 2021, leaving 2015-2020 undescribed. NASA's current OMNI availability documentation explicitly labels the full period through 2020 final; the application uses that documented period and does not infer status from the dataset title. The original HAPI description is preserved in dst-info.json and raw responses.

selection: Select only the source record whose documented averaging interval contains the selected UTC timestamp. The application never interpolates index values or uses the nearest available record to bridge a gap.
missing: A source fill value remains an explicit missing-value record; an absent record is separately identified; an HTTP/service/parse failure is reported as a load error.
boundary: HAPI time.max is exclusive. Bundled sample covers 2015-03-16T00:00:00Z <= selected time < 2015-03-19T00:00:00Z.
